prompt:
Premium editorial lifestyle product photograph for the crochet pattern collection "Little Halloween Costume Accessories": editorial lifestyle styled scene, like a boutique craft-magazine shoot.
Environment: a calm, softly lit home interior. Surface: plain natural linen over warm wood. Lighting: warm late-afternoon autumn light from one side, soft realistic shadows. Camera: eye-level three-quarter view from slightly above, 50 mm lens, gentle depth of field with the hero piece in sharp focus.
Composition: asymmetrical but balanced editorial composition with layered depth (foreground, middle ground, background); the hero piece is the dominant focal point; each supporting approved piece is used naturally and stays clearly readable; generous breathing room; never a flat catalogue grid. Palette: Black, White, Lavender, Orange, Yellow, warm walnut, natural linen, cream stoneware.

APPROVED CROCHET OBJECTS — the ONLY crochet or yarn items in the image: exactly 3, one of each:
1. HERO (dominant focal piece): Moonlit Bat Hair Clip [pattern bat-hair-clip]: placed naturally where it is clearly visible
2. Lavender Witch-Hat Brooch [pattern witch-hat-brooch]: resting naturally
3. Candy-Corn Bag Charm [pattern candy-corn-bag-charm]: resting naturally on the surface

NON-CROCHET PROPS (real objects, never crochet, knitted or yarn; use only these): a few dried berries, small pinecones, a lit pillar candle, a sprig of real dried autumn leaves.

FORBIDDEN CROCHET OBJECTS: crochet placemats, crochet table runners, crochet coasters, crochet napkin rings, crochet cutlery pockets or pouches, crochet appliqués, crochet garlands or bunting, crochet baskets, crochet cushions, crochet blankets or throws, crochet scarves, crochet ornaments, crochet toys or amigurumi, crochet doilies, crochet flowers, loose crochet leaves, loose or extra crochet leaves, flowers or motifs, a second copy of any approved piece, any crochet, knitted or yarn item not listed under APPROVED CROCHET OBJECTS, text, lettering, labels, logos, watermarks, price tags or packaging, hands or people.

CROCHET REALISM (product layer of the authoritative crochet direction): every crochet piece must look physically crocheted from yarn, photorealistic, high-end realistic product photography, clearly visible yarn fibres, visible crochet stitches, realistic loops, petal construction and stitch definition, genuine handmade depth and small imperfections, proper soft shadows and real dimensionality, believable yarn thickness, crochet stems, leaves and flowers where relevant.
The crochet must NOT look watercolour painted, hand illustrated, flat vector art, digitally painted, porcelain, plastic, like real biological flowers, like generic floral clipart.
No text, lettering, labels, logos, watermarks, price tags or packaging anywhere in the image. No hands or people.
